title: Shoes Also Need Personality
synopsis: If you plan on buying shoes in China, it will be easier if you know some basic terminology. After studying this lesson you can surely go shoe shopping with confidence.

fullText.simplified:
鞋子也要有个性

导购：请问您想要买些什么？
小艾：我想买一双高跟鞋，来配我的礼服。
导购：您觉得这双怎么样？
小艾：款式挺好的，但是跟有点高，而且鞋帮太硬了。还有别的款式吗？
导购：那这一款怎么样？这双可是我们店里的爆款。
小艾：街上所有人都穿着这款鞋。但是我不喜欢跟风，我想买一双特别一点的。
导购：我们正巧有一款很个性的鞋！
小艾：真的吗？快给我瞧瞧！
导购：您看，怎么样？
小艾：真不错。我可以试试吗？我穿39码的。
导购：当然可以，请稍等一下。
小艾：好像大了一点，能麻烦给我小一码的吗？
导购：没问题。
小艾：谢谢！
fullText.traditional:
鞋子也要有個性

導購：請問您想要買些什麼？
小艾：我想買一雙高跟鞋，來配我的禮服。
導購：您覺得這雙怎麼樣？
小艾：款式挺好的，但是跟有點高，而且鞋幫太硬了。還有別的款式嗎？
導購：那這一款怎麼樣？這雙可是我們店裡的爆款。
小艾：街上所有人都穿著這款鞋。但是我不喜歡跟風，我想買一雙特別一點的。
導購：我們正巧有一款很個性的鞋！
小艾：真的嗎？快給我瞧瞧！
導購：您看，怎麼樣？
小艾：真不錯。我可以試試嗎？我穿39碼的。
導購：當然可以，請稍等一下。
小艾：好像大了一點，能麻煩給我小一碼的嗎？
導購：沒問題。
小艾：謝謝！

raw.synopsis: If you plan on buying shoes in China, it will be easier if you know some basic terminology. After studying this lesson you can surely go shoe shopping with confidence.
sentence_translations: Shop assistant: How can I help you?
Xiaoai: I want to buy a pair of high heels to go with my cocktail dress.
Shop assistant: What do you think about these?
Xiaoai: The style is good, but the heel is a bit too high. Plus, the upper part is too stiff. Do you have any others?
Shop assistant: Then, how about these? These are the bestsellers here.
Xiaoai: Everyone on the street is wearing them. But I don't like to go with the tide. I want to buy something unique.
Shop assistant: We just happen to have one pair of shoes with a great personality!
Xiaoai: Really? Let me have a look!
Shop assistant: Here. What do you think?
Xiaoai: Pretty neat. Can I try them on? I am a size 39.
Shop assistant: Of course. Just one moment.
Xiaoai: I am afraid they are a bit too big. Can I have one size smaller?
